spanish: Y si hembra diere a luz, y se impurecerá dos semanas como su menstruación, y sesenta días y seis días se sentará sobre sangres de purificación.

findings.issue: Qal 3fs תלד already carries its subject, and preverbal נקבה is not marked as object; Spanish makes hembra the one who gives birth and states no child borne.
menstruación takes H5079 as the menstrual flow; the lemma also licenses impurity or separation, and the noun plus 3fs suffix does not decide.

notes: Dual dos semanas, the sixty-and-six day split, plural sangres, and qal 3fs se sentará sobre match; singular יוֹם with sesenta is Spanish number agreement.
